interactions.note: The 1d4 rider depends on the roll having Advantage. When Disadvantage cancels it (adjacent enemy for the Shortbow, long range, explicit Disadvantage) there should be no 1d4. This is the stage A ambiguity, Reading A. The engine follows it (roll.mode == 'advantage').

interactions.with: static damage (GLOSS stat block p.189, game.fixed_monster_damage)
interactions.note: The static form is '5 ... plus 2'. The engine's fixed-damage branch skips adv_extra entirely. Found: red.
A crit with Advantage doubles the rider's 1d4 as well. The engine does this (green).

interactions.with: EQUIP.weapons.properties.range / ranged attack with an enemy within 5 ft
interactions.note: Long range or an adjacent enemy gives Disadvantage, which cancels Advantage, so the rider doesn't apply. Green.

interactions.with: GLOSS.hide (DC 15 Stealth, cover or Heavy Obscurement, Invisible)
interactions.note: Stealth +6 against DC 15 has its boundary at 9/8. Hiding in plain view is refused. A failed Hide still spends the Bonus Action.
After a Nimble Escape Disengage, leaving reach provokes nothing and the action stays free.

interactions.with: PLAY.actions.bonus-actions (one per turn, own turn only)
interactions.note: A second Bonus Action is refused (green). Off-turn use is refused, but the refusal cites no page (red).
The 2024 Goblin is Fey, so Hold Person does nothing and the slot is spent.

interactions.with: skill bonus fixed by the stat block
interactions.note: The listed +6 is used as written, and unlisted Dex skills fall back to Dex +2.
Darkness reads as Dim and Dim as Bright up to 60 ft, and not beyond.
50 XP split three ways gives 16 each (rounded down).

interactions.note: The engine stores a fixed stat-block AC (gear_ac). Nothing is tested without a ruling.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: MONSTER.goblins.goblin-warrior: 'if the attack roll had Advantage'. Does the 1d4 rider apply when Advantage and Disadvantage cancel?
rulings_proposed.ruling: Reading A. The roll has Advantage only if it is actually rolled with Advantage. When Disadvantage cancels it (GLOSS.advantage: they cancel each other), the roll has neither and the extra 1d4 is not added. This holds whatever causes the Disadvantage: long range, a hostile creature within 5 ft of a ranged attacker, or any other source.

output.summary:
I wrote 66 tests for the Goblin Warrior in a new file, tests/srd/test_monsters.py, covering all 22 clauses. 60 pass and 6 are marked as known failures (strict xfail, claim red). Every clause has a positive test and a negative or boundary test, and Nimble Escape has abuse tests.

Engine findings (red):
- In static-damage mode (game.fixed_monster_damage), the engine drops the '+2 (1d4) if the attack roll had Advantage' rider, for both the Scimitar and the Shortbow.
- Nimble Escape resolves any option other than 'disengage' as Hide, so 'dash' with cover hides the goblin instead of being refused.
- Three refusals cite no SRD page or rule: Nimble Escape off-turn ('It isn't X's turn'), Nimble Escape for a creature without the trait, and an attack name that isn't in the stat block.

Green findings: the data and core mechanics match the SRD. That covers the Advantage rider when Advantage and Disadvantage cancel (one d20, no d4), crit doubling of the rider, reach and range limits, the DC 15 Hide boundary with Stealth +6, the Darkvision 60 ft boundary, Passive Perception 9, and the XP award with the R-02 split. Being Fey (not Humanoid), the goblin is unaffected by Hold Person; that test uses R-15.

I acted on the stage B verdict for MON-02 by adding the missing assertions to test_mon02_traits: no rider without Advantage, no rider when Advantage is cancelled, and the Shortbow rider. The new attacks target a separate standing JOZAN because BROM is Prone in that scenario. I added three new cheats to the abuse catalogue.

Proposed ruling: Reading A for the cancelled-Advantage rider (no 1d4). One infra ticket: the engine has no way to use the static Initiative score (12) instead of rolling.

Not tested, because no ruling exists: whether AC is recalculated if the goblin loses its Shield or armor (the engine stores a fixed AC), and whether a monster's Shortbow ammunition is tracked. I didn't add a row to docs/scenario-notes.md: the MON-02 change acts on an under-asserts verdict, which needs no note, and no scenario contradicted the SRD.
